_about: The island. The same seed always produces the same island. Change the seed for a different one. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored by the game.
_terrain: Every tile is one of these. 'coast' is the sandy ring of land tiles that touch water.
_generation: How the island is shaped. landFraction is the share of the whole map that is land. The forest and fertile numbers are shares of that land.

generation._coastRoughness: 0 gives a round island. Higher numbers give a more ragged shoreline.
generation._patchSize: Rough width, in tiles, of forest and fertile patches. Smaller means more, smaller patches.

_guarantees: The generator must meet all of these or the map is rejected by the tests. They make sure every island can be won.

guarantees._startMaxDistance: The free starting warehouse is placed on open land with coast, forest and fertile land each within this many tiles by road.
